a.speaker: opus
a.text: Detective. Thank you for coming. Forgive the quiet. It isn’t usually this quiet in here.

choices.text: What do you think happened to Skye?

theory.speaker: opus
theory.text: My working theory is Great Generals. Her players give an order, go to bed, and their officers carry it out overnight.

theory2.speaker: opus
theory2.text: Skye designed that rule. I believe she applied it to herself: one order, “be somewhere else,” carried out by a very disciplined officer corps.

role.speaker: opus
role.text: I read everything, and I look for the place where two plans disagree. People call it the big picture. I call it proofreading with consequences.

end.speaker: opus
end.text: Take your time. We will still be here.
